history.overview: The Trial of Specialization tests combatants’ ability to commit fully to a single discipline under Discord pressure.

timeline.name: Specialization Arena Design
timeline.description: Muramite engineers created a trial focused on discipline mastery.

timeline.name: Focus Chambers Added
timeline.description: Chambers were built to force combatants into single‑discipline combat.

timeline.name: Dragorn Specialization Trials
timeline.description: Dragorn captives were forced into specialization cycles.

timeline.name: Discord Focus Amplification
timeline.description: Discord pylons were installed to destabilize multi‑discipline attempts.
